limitations: Prefix samples are not representative estimates. No full-corpus absence-of-leakage claim.
Whitespace-normalized overlap detects equality, not semantics; common short texts can be legitimate collisions.
All texts/labels retained; statistics flag issues, do not filter or relabel.
No models trained, no old English or controlled pilot used.
